changeSet.author: antigravity
changeSet.comment: Force complete all custom path progress records for lequocbaotxdh@gmail.com
changeSet.sql:
DO $$ DECLARE v_account_id UUID; BEGIN -- Find the account ID for lequocbaotxdh@gmail.com SELECT id INTO v_account_id FROM account WHERE email = 'lequocbaotxdh@gmail.com';
IF v_account_id IS NOT NULL THEN -- Insert completed custom path progress for the user's custom learning paths INSERT INTO custom_path_progress (id, custom_path_id, learning_unit_id, score, is_completed, created_at, updated_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), clp.id, q.id, 100, true, NOW(), NOW() FROM custom_learning_paths clp JOIN custom_path_levels cpl ON clp.id = cpl.custom_path_id JOIN learning_unit lvl ON cpl.level_id = lvl.id JOIN learning_unit q ON q.parent_id = lvl.id AND q.type = 'QUIZ' WHERE clp.student_id = v_account_id ON CONFLICT (custom_path_id, learning_unit_id) DO UPDATE SET is_completed = true, score = 100, updated_at = NOW(); END IF; END $$;
